answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 48920 Country: India Title: Dua Question: Is this Sunnah or Bida’h to read the following at night before sleep or not: 1. Durood - 10 times, 2. Alhamdu Sharif - 5 times, 3. Third Kalimah - 10 times, 4. Astaghfar - 10 times and in addition, 5. 1st Kalimah - 10 times, Question: (2) Can one recite tasbih or wazifah while he is lying down in the bed or masjid or elsewhere with the legs stretched out straight or he has to fold his legs and read. And even if someone reads this is there any harm. Please also give me any amal to do or any wazifah for barakah in the house and income. Answer ID: 48920 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 70/58/B=01/1435) (1) It is not proved from hadith to read these wirds; hence they are not sunnah. So if they are not recited by considering necessary then it is not bida’h, you may read them. Instead of the ones mentioned above, if you read the following dua before going to bed then it is better: اللهم باسمك اموت و احي one time, Ayatal Kursi one time, From آمن الرسول to the end of the Surah Al-Baqarah one time and Tasbih Fatimah. Then recite قل هوا لله احد، قل اعوذ برب الفلق، قل اعوذ برب الناس 3-3 times and blow on your hands each time and pass your hands over your whole body. Also read اللهم بارك لى فى الموت وفيما بعد الموت 25 times. It is sunnah to read these duas as they are proved from the holy Prophet Muhammad (صلى الله عليه وسلم). You shall receive more reward in it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
